name: wayland
description: Core Wayland library: the client/server protocol implementation (libwayland-client, libwayland-server) and wayland-scanner, the code generator that turns protocol XML into C bindings.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
